caribbean.headline: Small Craft Conditions Near Roatan, Eastern Caribbean Breezy
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing southeasterly winds to 21 kt, seas to 5.9 ft with a dominant E swell at a 9 s period, and 25% rain probability. I expect Small Craft Advisory conditions near Roatan as winds meet the 20 to 33 kt threshold, and I’m monitoring St. Maarten where winds to 19 kt will produce fresh short‑period chop for ferries and small vessels.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Faces 20 kt Winds and 5.6 ft Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is seeing northerly winds up to 20 kt with significant wave heights near 5.6 ft, a dominant NNW swell at about a 6 s period, and less than 10% rain probability. I expect conditions to remain moderate across the eastern Mediterranean while Marseille sees lighter winds near 17 kt, so I advise routine small-boat caution for exposed areas.
